categories.main_business_segments: MSCI operates through three primary reportable segments: Index, Analytics, and ESG and Climate. The Index segment provides equity and fixed income indexes used for benchmarking, portfolio construction, and as the basis for investment products. The Analytics segment offers risk management, performance attribution, and portfolio management tools. The ESG and Climate segment delivers data, ratings, and research to help investors integrate sustainability and climate considerations. Additionally, Real Assets and Private Capital Solutions are combined and reported as 'All Other – Private Assets,' offering data and analytics for private assets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: MSCI leverages proprietary research, advanced data analytics, and technology platforms, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, and cloud-based solutions. Its products are developed by interdisciplinary teams of mathematicians, economists, statisticians, and financial engineers. The company emphasizes open-architecture platforms, APIs, and integration with client workflows, and continually invests in data science and automation to enhance data quality, scalability, and client experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MSCI serves a broad spectrum of the global investment industry, including asset owners (pension funds, endowments, sovereign wealth funds), asset managers (mutual funds, hedge funds, ETFs), financial intermediaries (banks, broker-dealers, exchanges), wealth managers, real estate professionals, and corporates. Its solutions are widely used for portfolio construction, risk management, regulatory reporting, and the creation of investment products.
categories.geographic_coverage: MSCI has a global footprint, serving approximately 7,100 clients in over 100 countries. Its largest markets are the Americas (notably the United States), EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), and Asia-Pacific, with significant operations and clients in the UK, Japan, and other major financial centers. The company maintains offices and employees across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: MSCI operates as a downstream provider in the financial services supply chain, delivering data, analytics, indexes, and decision-support tools directly to institutional investors, asset managers, and other financial market participants. It aggregates, processes, and analyzes data from various sources to create value-added products for end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: MSCI's strategic priorities include expanding research-enhanced content across asset classes, leading in sustainability and climate integration, enhancing technology and distribution platforms, empowering client customization, and growing through strategic partnerships and acquisitions. The company invests heavily in R&D, particularly in AI, data science, and cloud migration, to drive innovation and maintain its competitive edge.
categories.revenue_model: MSCI primarily generates revenue through recurring subscription fees for its data, analytics, and research products, as well as variable asset-based fees linked to assets under management in investment products based on its indexes. Additional revenue comes from non-recurring sources such as one-time licenses, implementation services, and historical data sales. The majority of revenue is recurring and subscription-based, providing stable and predictable cash flows.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors in the Index segment include S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, Nasdaq, Bloomberg, and Solactive. In Analytics, competitors include Axioma, BlackRock Solutions, Bloomberg, and FactSet. ESG and Climate competitors include Sustainalytics (Morningstar), ISS (Deutsche Börse), S&P Global, Refinitiv, and Bloomberg. MSCI is recognized as a global leader and innovator, particularly in indexes and ESG, with strong brand recognition and client relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, MSCI reported $2.86 billion in operating revenues, representing a 12.9% year-over-year increase. Adjusted EBITDA was $1.72 billion (60.1% margin), and net income was $1.11 billion. The company has demonstrated consistent revenue and profit growth, driven by recurring revenues and strong cash generation, and continues to invest in expansion and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MSCI differentiates itself through research-driven, technology-enabled solutions that provide critical insights into risk, return, and sustainability for global investors. Its integrated platforms, proprietary data, and advanced analytics enable clients to make informed investment decisions, manage risk, and meet regulatory requirements. The company emphasizes client-centricity, innovation, and the ability to deliver customizable, scalable solutions across asset classes and geographies.
